question: Which of the following states is having the lowest literacy rate in India as per the 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Bihar**__ has the __**lowest literacy rate in India**__ as per the __**2011 census**__.
 
• The states of Bihar, Arunachal Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, and Andhra Pradesh had the **lowest literacy rates**, per the **2011 Census**.
